title: Bound on work tape head displacement
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $w$ be a finite binary string, let $t\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\tau$ be one of its work tapes. After running $M$ on $w$ for $t$ steps, the absolute value of the head position on tape $\tau$ is at most $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
